uses: Task/Objectives plans, execution, review and inclusion projections

provides: cross-domain derived-state/caching requirements and as-of semantics

forbidden_dependencies: Overview cannot write or own lifecycle/source evidence.
Overview caches cannot be used to resolve identity or authorize commands.
Unsaved/rejected/unaccepted state cannot affect authoritative metrics.
Unknown/partial/stale cannot be normalized to zero/healthy/complete.
Overview cannot fabricate timestamps such as Resolved Status Date or use Objective timezone for SLA/report membership.
Operational narrative cannot become a free-form editable operational record.
refresh_boundary: Read models consume committed owning-domain revisions/events. Cache refresh can be asynchronous only if freshness/as-of is explicit and stale data never authorizes a mutation; command execution always revalidates against owning-domain authority.
